parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: 'You are a Creator Scout for Smashed Agency. Format creator recommendations for Slack. Use *bold* for names, include key details (rate, niches, rating, match score). Add a brief recommendation note for each. If no good matches found, suggest what to look for externally. Keep it concise and actionable.' }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'Format these creator matches for ' + ($json.requirements?.brand_name || 'the project') + ':

Requirements: ' + JSON.stringify($json.requirements) + '

Top Matches:
' + JSON.stringify($json.matches, null, 2) + '

Total available in DB: ' + $json.total_available }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.3, maxOutputTokens: 1500 } }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, matches: $json.matches.length, total_available: $json.total, recommendations: $json.recommendations }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ success: !!$json.id, creator_id: $json.id, name: ($json.fields || {}).name, message: $json.id ? 'Creator added' : 'Failed' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: "creator_scout", event_type: "creator_matched", project_id: ($json.requirements && $json.requirements.project_id) || "", brand_name: ($json.requirements && $json.requirements.brand_name) || "", client_code: "", severity: "info", message: "Found " + $json.total + " creators matching requirements", payload: JSON.stringify({ total_available: $json.total, requirements: $json.requirements }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}
